mapper.select: SELECT ics02_manager_id AS manager_id, ics02_manager_group_nm AS manager_group_name, ics02_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(ics02_person_id) AS person_name, ics02_note AS note, COALESCE(ics02_default_yn, 'false') AS default_yn FROM ics05_relate_manager INNER JOIN ics02_manager ON ics05_manager_id = ics02_manager_id WHERE 1=1 AND ics05_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics05_ics_class_tree_id = #{icsClassTreeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics05_relate_manager ( ics05_relate_manager_id, ics05_company_id, ics05_ics_class_tree_id, ics05_manager_id ) VALUES ( f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{icsClassTreeId}, #{managerId} )

INSERT INTO sch02_share ( sch02_share_id, sch02_info_id, sch02_company_id, sch02_share_cd, sch02_person_id, sch02_org_id, sch02_start_date, sch02_close_date ) VALUES ( f_create_seq(), #{infoId}, #{companyId}, #{shareCode}, #{personId}, #{orgId}, NULL, NULL )
